# hg chatops

**What this page tells you:** every `hg chatops` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Chatops spaces: list, plan, render, tail, test.

## Synopsis

```text
hg chatops list [flags]
hg chatops plan [flags]
hg chatops render [<alias>#<destination>] [flags]
hg chatops tail
hg chatops test [<alias>#<destination>] [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

`list`/`plan`/`render` are OFFLINE (`render` never sends); `test` delivers one message through the environment's REAL provider binding.

## `hg chatops list`

```text
hg chatops list [flags]
```

Declared spaces.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo>` | — | The declaring repo. |

## `hg chatops plan`

```text

```

The compiled space plan.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo>` | — | The declaring repo. |

## `hg chatops render`

```text
hg chatops render [<alias>#<destination>] [flags]
```

Render a message offline — never sends.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--event` | `<event>` | — | The event to render. |
| `--payload` | `<file.json>` | — | The payload to render with. |
| `--dir` | `<repo>` | — | The declaring repo. |

## `hg chatops tail`

```text
hg chatops tail
```

The recording sink's captured messages (was: inspect).

## `hg chatops test`

```text
hg chatops test [<alias>#<destination>] [flags]
```

|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo>` | — | The declaring repo. |
